prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE collectible achievement sticker icon for Aqualino, a hydration app. Primary request: a charismatic little AQUATIC OTTER character enthusiastically drinking water from an oversized turquoise sports bottle, celebrating their first sip. Original premium 2D mobile game character illustration with the visual craftsmanship of playful language learning app achievement awards: dynamic asymmetric pose, expressive confident eyelids and brows, rounded chunky silhouette, tiny paws, warm brown and cream fur, very simple flat colored shapes with selective cel shading. A loose turquoise and pale yellow medal wreath frames the lower half, character and bottle break outside its silhouette; two small coral confetti marks. Bold clean graphic composition readable at 80 pixels. Centered square canvas, complete icon occupies 85%, isolated on genuinely transparent alpha background. No white rectangular background. No words, no letters, NO NUMBERS (added natively in the app). Avoid teardrop-shaped blob characters, identical round medallions, clipart, 3D, glossy metallic materials, realistic texture, thin linework. The result must feel like a lovingly art-directed collectible character with a story, not a generic emoji.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE collectible achievement character sticker icon for Aqualino hydration app. Original premium playful 2D mobile game achievement illustration. Loosely framed at lower half by a simple turquoise open wreath with small pale yellow shell at bottom; character breaks outside wreath. Square canvas, whole icon fully visible centered with 8% clear padding, real transparent alpha background. NO text, letters, numbers, white rectangle, 3D metallic medallion, realistic textures, tiny details, teardrop blob mascot. Keep shapes simple and colors bold. Subject: a cheerful navy blue and white PENGUIN wearing a coral sweatband, energetically ringing a small golden alarm clock and holding a tiny cyan water bottle. Dynamic three-quarter pose, one flipper raised.
